say:1:1711152001:1.text: Lord Merlin, we have brought Kraft back.
say:1:1711152001:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，我们把克拉夫特抓回来了。

say:5:1711152004:1.text: I am just an ordinary landscape consultant employed by the cemetery management office.
say:5:1711152004:1.source_cn: 我只是一位受雇于墓园管理处的，普通的园艺景观顾问。

choice_prompt:7:1711152005.text: As for the "Crawford magician who died young" you mentioned, my resemblance to him was just Aya's joke.
choice_prompt:7:1711152005.source_cn: 至于你们口中那位“英年早逝的克拉夫特魔法师”，我与他容貌上的相似只是艾雅的玩笑罢了。

say:8:1711152006:1.text: Your Excellency, I do not understand what you mean.

say:11:1711152009:1.text: Simply request to use a mantra array on you once, or verify your magic registration information—
say:11:1711152009:1.source_cn: 只要申请对你使用一次真言法阵，或者核对你的魔力登记信息——

say:12:1711152010:1.text: Sigh, why resort to such crude methods? What difference would it make if I admitted it?
say:12:1711152010:1.source_cn: 唉，何必动用那种粗鲁的手段呢？我即使承认了又有什么关系？

say:13:1711152011:1.text: I only took some "expedient measures" to avoid the recent political turmoil.
say:13:1711152011:1.source_cn: 我只是为了规避前阵子的政治动荡，而采取了一些“权宜之计”。

choice_prompt:14:1711152011.text: I only took some "expedient measures" to avoid the recent political turmoil.
choice_prompt:14:1711152011.source_cn: 我只是为了规避前阵子的政治动荡，而采取了一些“权宜之计”。

say:15:1711152012:1.text: ...Thanks to you, Lord Merlin. The environment there is indeed very beneficial for mana recovery.
say:15:1711152012:1.source_cn: ……托您的福，梅林阁下。那里的环境确实对魔力恢复大有裨益。

say:16:1711152014:1.text: Is the "Bantis Border Survey Report" also your expedient measure?
say:16:1711152014:1.source_cn: 《班题斯边境调研报告》，也是你的权宜之计吗？

say:17:1711152015:1.text: Of course. After Lord Dilgrey's accident, the Affairs Department was in complete chaos.
say:17:1711152015:1.source_cn: 当然。迪尔格雷大人出事后，事务司一片混乱。

choice_prompt:20:1711152016.text: As a seasoned magician, I should move the confidential report to a safer location for proper storage. This is a wise move to prevent any potential problems.
choice_prompt:20:1711152016.source_cn: 作为资深魔法师，我理应将机密报告转移到更安全的地方妥善保管。这是防患于未然的明智之举。

say:21:1711152017:1.text: You ignored Kraft's platitudes and instead threw out your trump card.
say:21:1711152017:1.source_cn: 你懒得理克拉夫特的套话理由，而是直接抛出了致命底牌。

say:23:1711152019:1.text: Oh, Lord Merlin, you must have been misled by some false rumors.
say:23:1711152019:1.source_cn: 哦，梅林阁下，您一定是被某些不实的流言误导了。

say:24:1711152020:1.text: As a subordinate, my relationship with former Chief Executive Officer Deergray was merely that of a superior and subordinate.
say:24:1711152020:1.source_cn: 作为下属，我与迪尔格雷前首席之间，仅仅维持着上下级关系。

say:27:1711152022:1.text: If you were unaware of the situation, why did you immediately fake your death to escape after Deer Grey's accident?
say:27:1711152022:1.source_cn: 如果你不知情，迪尔格雷出事后，你为什么要立刻假死脱身？

say:29:1711152024:1.text: Save your arguments for the judge!
say:29:1711152024:1.source_cn: 你的这些说辞，留着跟法官说吧！

choice_prompt:32:1711152025.text: Conviction requires solid evidence and witness testimony! This person I've never met before—let me call him a magician for now—don't try to intimidate a respected senior with a few laws!
choice_prompt:32:1711152025.source_cn: 定罪是需要确凿的人证物证的！这位从没见过的，我姑且成为魔法师吧。你别妄图拿着几条律法，就来恐吓一位有资历的前辈！

choice_prompt:38:1711152030.text: For example, the "Bantis Border Survey Report" that you've been investigating. Dillgreat's original instruction was for me to destroy it completely.
choice_prompt:38:1711152030.source_cn: 比如你们一直追查的那份《班题斯边境调研报告》。迪尔格雷原本的指令，是让我将它彻底销毁。

say:39:1711152031:1.text: I have no idea about that, after all, it's a report that I painstakingly researched and wrote.
say:39:1711152031:1.source_cn: 这我就不得而知了，毕竟这也是我辛辛苦苦调研写出的报告。

say:40:1711152032:1.text: So... I didn't destroy it, but kept it with me.
say:40:1711152032:1.source_cn: 所以……我并没有销毁它，而是把它留在了身边。

choice_prompt:41:1711152032.text: So... I didn't destroy it, but kept it with me.
choice_prompt:41:1711152032.source_cn: 所以……我并没有销毁它，而是把它留在了身边。

say:42:1711152033:1.text: It was in that guardhouse hut, hidden in a secret compartment under the floorboards.
say:42:1711152033:1.source_cn: 就在那栋看守小屋里，藏在地板下面的暗格中。

say:44:1711152035:1.text: Or perhaps they simply assist in magical experiments or take notes.
say:44:1711152035:1.source_cn: 或者在某些魔法实验中打打下手、做做记录而已。

choice_prompt:46:1711152036.text: I assure you, Your Excellency Merlin, these are merely insignificant peripheral tasks, and certainly not serious crimes.
choice_prompt:46:1711152036.source_cn: 我向您保证，梅林阁下，这些都只是些无关痛痒的边缘工作，绝对算不上什么严重的罪行。

say:51:1711152040:1.text: Lord Merlin! Since the report is in the guardhouse, please allow me to go there and look for it!
say:51:1711152040:1.source_cn: 梅林大人！既然报告就在看守小屋，请允许我去那里寻找！

choice_prompt:52:1711152040.text: Lord Merlin! Since the report is in the guardhouse, please allow me to go there and look for it!
choice_prompt:52:1711152040.source_cn: 梅林大人！既然报告就在看守小屋，请允许我去那里寻找！

say:53:1711152041:1.text: Lord Merlin, let's go to the secret chamber now... Dillgret's secret chamber...
say:53:1711152041:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，那我们现在过去密室吧……迪尔格雷的密室……

choice:46:1:2.text: What you've actually done is probably much more than that.
choice:46:1:2.source_cn: 你实际做的，应该远不止这些吧

choice:32:0:1.text: Since you won't tell me, then I'll have no choice but to hand you over to Eve.
choice:32:0:1.source_cn: 既然你不肯说，那就只能把你交给伊芙

choice:32:1:2.text: Either tell the truth, or you'll spend your life in prison.
choice:32:1:2.source_cn: 要么说实话，要么你就蹲一辈子监狱吧

choice:20:1:2.text: You're keeping this to cover up evidence, aren't you?
choice:20:1:2.source_cn: 你的保管是为了掩盖罪证吧

choice:14:0:1.text: You've managed to "avoid" it quite well.

say:56:1711152013:1.text: Time was of the essence, so I didn't do anything unnecessary.
say:56:1711152013:1.source_cn: 时间紧迫，我并没有做什么多余的事情。

choice:14:1:2.text: You're not just avoiding it, are you?

choice:7:0:1.text: You're just putting up a last-ditch effort.
choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 你现在只是在负隅顽抗

say:57:1711152007:1.text: First of all, I am not Kraft. Secondly, your sarcasm is a bit rude.
say:57:1711152007:1.source_cn: 首先，我不是克拉夫特。其次，您的讽刺有点失礼。

choice:7:1:2.text: You died with a rosy complexion, Mr. Kraft.
choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 你“死”得面色红润啊，克拉夫特先生
